units.time: building-local naive timestamp; no timezone conversion

metadata.join_policy: Prediction and anomaly results are separate datasets with different coverage. Do not join them by row position or fill missing anomaly coverage as normal.

overview.prediction_target: mean total_AC_power_kw from t+1 to t+15 within the same zone

limitations: Anomalies are candidates, not verified equipment faults; no anomaly accuracy/precision/recall/F1 is claimed.
IF raw scores from separate period models are not comparable globally; percentile is relative rank, not fault probability.
Jaccard measures agreement, not correctness. Baseline is a sanity reference, not ground truth.
Official IF labels select 5% per period as an alert budget. This is not an estimated true fault rate. Auto labels are reference only.
Anomaly and forecast rows cover different ranges and preprocessing versions; do not join by row position or fill absent anomaly coverage with normal labels.
Hourly means are chart data; calculate metrics from minute errors or sufficient statistics.
Sep6 issue-time data includes target windows ending on Sep7; declare date basis.
Test RF MAE is higher than persistence for evening_off, night_off and weekend; overall improvement does not apply everywhere.
